paper_metadata.title: Recipes for building an open-domain chatbot
paper_metadata.abstract: Building open-domain chatbots is a challenging area for machine learning research. While prior work has shown that scaling neural models in the number of parameters and the size of the data they are trained on gives improved results, we show that other ingredients are important for a high-performing chatbot. Good conversation requires a number of skills that an expert conversationalist blends in a seamless way: providing engaging talking points and listening to their partners, and displaying knowledge, empathy and personality appropriately, while maintaining a consistent persona. We show that large scale models can learn these skills when given appropriate training data and choice of generation strategy. We build variants of these recipes with 90M, 2.7B and 9.4B parameter models, and make our models and code publicly available. Human evaluations show our best models are superior to existing approaches in multi-turn dialogue in terms of engagingness and humanness measurements. We then discuss the limitations of this work by analyzing failure cases of our models.

extraction_data.innovation: Fine-tuning on BlendedSkillTalk (BST) dataset to blend knowledge, empathy, and personality; systematic control of generation strategies (decoding algorithms and beam search length constraints) to manage response length and engagement; targeted fine-tuning to minimize undesirable traits like toxicity.
extraction_data.paper_title: Recipes for building an open-domain chatbot
extraction_data.training_pipeline: Pre-training on large corpora -> fine-tuning on BST dataset
extraction_data.benchmark_result: Human evaluations: 75% to 25% win rate over Meena in engagingness; 65% to 35% in humanness

extraction_data.innovation: Poly-encoder: uses multiple global context representations (ncodes) attended to by each candidate response for efficient retrieval; Generator: standard Seq2Seq Transformer for response generation; Retrieve-and-Refine: combines retrieval with generation to mitigate hallucination and repetition.
extraction_data.paper_title: Recipes for building an open-domain chatbot
extraction_data.training_pipeline: Pre-training on dialogue data, fine-tuning on ConvAI2
extraction_data.benchmark_result: Outperforms Meena in human evaluations (75% to 25% engagingness, 65% to 35% humanness)

extraction_data.innovation: Multi-task fine-tuning on blended conversational datasets (ConvAI2, Empathetic Dialogues, Wizard of Wikipedia, Blended Skill Talk) to seamlessly combine personality, empathy, and knowledge; retrieval-and-refine architecture for knowledge grounding; safety mitigation via adversarial toxic data and explicit instructions to reduce undesirable language.
